items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Butch Miles on Drums... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah it just was great no matter where he was. He could play the Hollywood Bowl and sound great.

ctx.x: Butch Miles on Drums and it was just, it was heaven. And that you know I wish I would have saw some of their earlier bands there but that was just treated just as royally
